title: Swale
author: Ksd5 (Wikimedia Commons user; the file's license box reads "Created by Siddharth Patil")
description: Small swale trickling into a stream. Recorded 27 February 2011, own work.
attribution: none (CC0; the author asks for a note on their talk page, not required)
format: Ogg Vorbis, mono, 48 kHz, 31.0 s, the original file unchanged
use: the bamboo spout pouring into the Yuzu Spring's pool: layer 'spout' of the hotspring_snow bed (tools/cozy/audio/recorded.py)
processing: decoded to 48 kHz (ffmpeg); 0.5 to 30.5 s used; its wind rumble cut (high-pass near 160 Hz), the low mids lifted a little and the top softened (tools/cozy/audio/recorded.py RECORDINGS eq); cut into two seamless loops from its two halves (12.0 and 11.1 s, loop points chosen by band-energy similarity, 2 s equal-power crossfades); the two loops placed either side of a point right of center; peaks over 15 dB above its RMS limited; the bed blends the two loops with a slow seeded balance and a level breathing about 1 dB
why_not_freesound: Freesound answered 403 (blocked) to every request for the rest of the session after a search on 2026-11-12, so this CC0 recording came from Wikimedia Commons; heard blind by the audio model as pouring or flowing water, a real recording, no problems
